title: Netflix's 'Call My Agent!' movie trailer is formidable fun
content_html:
The gang's back together. Eeeep.

 

By

Shannon Connellan

Shannon Connellan

Senior Editor

Shannon Connellan is Mashable's Senior Editor, General Assignments, based in London. She has been Mashable's UK Editor (and still manages the illustrious UK team) and Australia Editor, but emotionally, she lives searching for Exit 8. A Tomatometer-approved critic, Shannon writes about entertainment, tech, social good, science, culture, and Australian horror, and loves to nerd out with movie stars, filmmakers, and TV creators.

on August 24, 2026

Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share on Flipboard

Call My Agent! fans, the long-awaited film arrive bientôt.

After four lauded seasons, the beloved French comedy series wrapped in 2020. Directed by Emilinie Noblet and written by Call My Agent! creator Fanny Herrero with Lison Daniel, Call My Agent! The Movie reconnects with the illustrious ASK talent agency crew, five years after the doors shut for good.

Andréa (Camille Cottin) has pivoted to the director's chair, helming her first feature — and it's a bit of a disaster. Noémie (Laure Calamy) is kicking goals producing major reality TV series. When the lead walks off Andréa's set, she'll need a damn good producer and a taste for humble pie. With Noémie and Andréa reunited, a storm of dramatic happenings brews on and off camera. So, they'll need a hand from the whole ASK crew — but grudges and egos are hard to shake.

Call My Agent's Thibault de Montalembert, Grégory Montel, Nicolas Maury, Fanny Sidney, Liliane Rovère, Laetitia Casta, Vincent Macaigne, Ophélia Kolb, Anne Marivin and Laurent Lafitte also star.

Call My Agent! The Movie is streaming on Netflix Sept 10.
